text.p: The new issue of Polish construction company Mostostal Warszawa SA of 1.5 million shares was oversubscribed with investors subscribing for 3,206,065 shares, the company said in a statement.
It said in the large investors 1.2-million-share tranche investors subscribed for 2,900,880 shares and in the retail 300,000-share tranche 305,185 shares were subscribed.

In the large investors tranche only investors, who had at least 10,000 Mostostal's shares before the issue and had been given preference over other investors, were allotted shares with bids reduced by 57.3 percent.
In the small investor tranche the bids were reduced by 1.7 percent. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
